summary: Tested Categories management feature end-to-end (backend APIs + Admin UI + Shop chips + ProductModal dropdown). Found and fixed a critical bug in Shop.js where 'wholesale' variable was undefined, causing ReferenceError and 'Something went wrong' page on /shop.

ui_bugs.issue: 'wholesale' variable used at lines 45, 66, 120 but never defined in component. Caused ReferenceError → 'Something went wrong' error boundary on /shop page.

critical_code_review_comments: Shop.js had 'wholesale' variable used without being defined — added 'const wholesale = user?.customer_type === "wholesale" && user?.approved;' — already fixed in this iteration.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ categories during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Categories feature fully working: 6 seed categories in DB, admin can add/rename/delete, delete blocked for categories with products, shop chips loaded from API (not hardcoded), ProductModal dropdown uses live API. Critical bug fixed: Shop.js missing 'wholesale' variable definition — fixed by adding const wholesale = user?.customer_type === 'wholesale' && user?.approved.
